reasoning: A standalone Rust HTTP server built with axum/tokio, producing a single 'regex-detector' binary. It binds to HOST:HTTP_PORT (default 0.0.0.0:8080) and exposes GET /health and POST /api/v1/text/contents, where it checks text against built-in patterns (ssn, credit-card, email) or custom regexes. The README describes it as a detection service for the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator. The Dockerfile builds a UBI-minimal release image that runs the binary as a long-running process. There are no CRDs, controllers or reconcile logic, so it is not an operator. It is not consumed as a library and is not configuration-only. It is a deployable network service.
